Context: 10. T.A. on Transfer

- (i) a Composite Transfer Grant equal to 80 per cent of last month's Basic Pay; No other add-ons should be allowed in Basic Pay while calculating CTG. (Not admissible if no change of residence is involved even where the distance between the two stations is more than 20 kms.). For transfer to and from the island territories of Andaman, Nicobar and Lakshadweep, CTG may continue to be paid at 100 per cent. - GIOs (1) and (4), SR 116.
- PWBY
